title: A primitive marked Globally Active with no Instances is authorized capability the Agent has not yet used
content:
Among the SkyLink and Demand Side Stablecoin Primitives, Launch Agent 7 shows two distinct empty states. Distribution Reward (A.6.1.1.8.2.5.1.1.1) and Integration Boost (A.6.1.1.8.2.5.2.1.1) are `Active` yet have no Instances in any directory. Token SkyLink (A.6.1.1.8.2.4.1.1.1) and Pioneer Chain (A.6.1.1.8.2.5.3.1.1) are `Inactive`, also with no Instances.

The pair is what makes the semantics readable. If `Active` meant "in use," the first two would be mislabeled. It instead means the primitive is switched on and available: an Invocation may begin at any time and, when it succeeds, its subtree moves into the Active Instances directory without any further authorization step.

So the Artifact distinguishes three things that a single flag would collapse — a capability not enabled (`Inactive`), enabled but unexercised (`Active`, no Instances), and in use (`Active` with Instances).

Read as a portfolio, this tells you what Launch Agent 7 has prepared for versus committed to. It has pre-authorized demand-side stablecoin tooling — rewards for distribution and integration boosts — while leaving cross-chain SkyLink deployment and Pioneer Chain participation switched off. Enabling the first pair required a governance decision that has already been taken; using them does not require another.
description: Distribution Reward and Integration Boost are Active with empty Instance directories, while Token SkyLink and Pioneer Chain are Inactive — switched-on-but-unused differs from not switched on.
